The '''Naboo Royal Advisory Council''', also known as '''Naboo High Council''' and the '''Governing Council''', was the governing body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and later, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
The Royal Advisory Council was formed to assist the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Monarch of Naboo]] in managing [[Standard day/Legends|day]]-to-day affairs, and was led by the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] from the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. The Council was made up of men and women in control of specific ministries in Theed, and included ministers for architecture, music, the sciences, and education. The governor of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] also had a seat on the council.<ref name="POSG">[[Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> It was noted that there had never been a [[Minister of War (Naboo)|minister of war]] during the [[Great Time of Peace/Legends|Great Time of Peace]]. The Council frequently altered its composition, so as to bring in a range of scholars, [[Artist/Legends|artists]] and interested community members. Council sessions were held in the [[Throne room (Theed Royal Palace)/Legends|throne room]] of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]].

==History==
Though members of the Advisory Council were captured during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and temporarily replaced by the [[Trade Federation Occupation Council|Occupation Council]], the Council was reinstated following the end of [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] occupation, and remained a vital part of Naboo's government throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Kylantha]] refused to disband the Council after the [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution]] of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], a move that was a point of concern for many [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]].

==Behind the scenes==
The reference book ''[[Secrets of Naboo]]'' limits the number of the councilmen to five, one permanent and four rotating. It also lists the four rotating positions as "Music Adviser," "Master of Sciences," "Chief Architect" and "Educational Regent." However, other sources such as ''[[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game]]'' mention additional positions, including "Minister of Culture" and "Assistant Minister of Internal Affairs." Additionally, more than five advisers appear together in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].
